faculty: Faculty of Engineering (East Port Said National University)

overview.text: Offers a modern engineering model that links core engineering knowledge with practical application and advanced technologies. Every student starts with a foundational preparatory year, then chooses one of three specializations: Mechatronics and Automation, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, or Energy and Electrical Power. Teaching combines theory, practical training and applied projects, aligned with labor-market needs.

vision.text: To be a distinguished learning environment in applied engineering education, innovation, and community service. A longer version adds: distinguished education and research that keeps pace with global developments, encourages innovation, builds effective local and international partnerships, and serves as a center of expertise for community service.

mission.text: Prepare engineering graduates who apply scientific knowledge and practical skills in mechatronics and automation, artificial intelligence and machine learning, and energy and electrical power, to design solutions that serve development and the labor market. The longer official text also covers advanced educational programs, continuing education, research laboratories, and support for faculty and students in applied research.
